propositions: GitHub is a read-only mirror; dependabot PRs #123 and #124 must be re-landed as three independent Gerrit changes (Change 0 for click security fix, Change A for setup-python v7 workflows, Change B for ruff/mcp bumps) and closed on GitHub by hand.
PR #123 bumps actions/setup-python from v6 to v7 across 13 workflow files with pinned SHAs; setup-python v7 requires ESM and node24 runner (provided by ubuntu-latest).

PR #124 proposes mcp 1.x → 2.0.0 (major, breaking) plus ruff 0.15.22 → 0.16.1; mcp 2.0 removes FastMCP and auth API v1 paths used in mcp_server.py/_mcp_auth.py/_mcp_models.py, requiring either full compatibility validation via test suite or deferral to a follow-up migration ticket.
click 8.2.1 → ≥8.3.3 (PYSEC-2026-2132 command injection fix) must be applied first as Change 0 in uv.lock via override-dependencies to unblock all CI gates blocked by pip-audit.

Change B path 1 (mcp 2.0 acceptance) requires updating .github/workflows/_optionality.yml constraint from <2 to <3 and amending ADR 0050 text; path 2 (mcp breakage) defers migration work to a follow-up ticket and retains mcp <2 constraint.

All three Gerrit changes apply PR diffs verbatim via git apply (byte-identical, including allowlist echo lines and SHA pins) to prevent retyping errors; PRs are closed after merge with provenance comments naming the landed Gerrit changes.
